figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. The lanostane triterpenoids from Antrodia camphorata and potential biosynthetic pathways. a) The main types of lanostane triterpenoids in
A. camphorata. b) The identiﬁed enzymes involved in the biosynthesis of lanostane triterpenoids in A. camphorata. c) The absence of essential
enzymes that need to be identiﬁed by this work to achieve heterologous biosynthesis of lanostane triterpenoids.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Candidate CPY450s for tailoring lanostane triterpenoids in A. camphorata. a) A proposed biosynthetic pathway of lanostane triterpenoids
with 21-COOH and/or 15-OH groups, or with rearranged lanostane skeleton. b) The reported CYP450s involved in the biosynthesis of lanostane
triterpenoids. c) The structural dendrogram of all the CYP450 candidates with CYP5035D1C31, HelB4, CYP512U6, AcCYP4, and CYP512W2. d) In vitro
screening of CYP450 candidates showed AcCYP1 and AcCYP2 led to the formation of new products indicated by GC-MS analysis. Before GC-MS
analysis, samples were trimethylsilylated with BSTFA. e) The LC-MS chromatograms and MS spectra of products catalyzed by AcCYP1 and AcCYP2.
The chromatograms were recorded at 210 nm.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. AcCYP1 and AcCYP2 tailor lanosterol with diﬀerent performance. a) The products of strains harboring AcCYP1 and AcCYP2 detected by
LC-MS. b) The chemical structures of products and related reactions catalyzed by AcCYP1 and AcCYP2. The percentages represent the proportion of
each oxidized product to the total oxidized products in the strain harboring AcCYP1. c) The proposed mechanism of rearranged lanostane skeleton
catalyzed by AcCYP1. d) Two docking models of lanosterol and AcCYP1 in molecular docking. e) The distance between lanosterol (C21/C15) and the
FeIV═O of AcCYP1 in two poses during 100 ns MD simulation. MD simulation indicates more proper distance between lanosterol and the FeIV═O for
C15 pose (blue) than C21 pose (green). f) The distance between H15 in 5 and the FeIV═O of AcCYP1 during 100 ns MD simulation. The distance of
H15 indicated that H15a in 5 could be ﬁrstly extracted. g) The H15b (labeled as orange) of rearranged product was pushed toward to the FeIV═O of
AcCYP1.
